item.title: Republican mayor rejects 'Lake America' name; says locals take renaming personally
item.description: The Republican mayor of Oswego has firmly opposed President Trump's executive order to rename Lake Ontario, emphasizing the importance of the lake's original name in shaping the community's identity. This decision has sparked bipartisan and international discontent among numerous political leaders, especially with the recent downturn in Canadian tourism to the U.S. Locals will persist in using the lake's historical name, rooted in Indigenous heritage.

item.title: San Antonio library book checked out in 1943 returns 82 years later
item.description: After 82 years, a library book borrowed in 1943 was finally returned in Oregon, revealing a heartfelt letter detailing its extensive journey. The family inquired about overdue fees, but fortunately, the library had abolished such fines in 2021. The book, still in excellent condition, was briefly showcased before being put up for sale.

item.title: AI may soon help humans talk to animals and birds
item.description: Artificial intelligence may soon enable humans to communicate with animals. Researchers are cataloguing and reproducing animal sounds using machine learning models. This technology raises ethical questions about animal privacy and potential misuse. Understanding animal signals could lead to manipulation and distress for wildlife. The pursuit of animal communication continues despite these significant ethical considerations.

item.title: Indian immigrant worked as janitor in US, later built businesses worth billions
item.description: Sharran Srivatsaa arrived in America as a freshman working as a janitor. He overcame his accent and financial struggles through self-education and hard work. Srivatsaa later joined Goldman Sachs and built two billion-dollar companies. He then became CEO of Acquisition.com in 2026. His story shows a remarkable career transformation from humble beginnings.

item.title: Make AI-merica Great Again: Meme Lord Trump’s digital feed goes off rails again
item.description: Donald Trump posted numerous AI-generated images on Truth Social over the weekend. These images ranged from self-congratulatory to geopolitically consequential, causing confusion. The posts included depictions of historical figures and geopolitical scenarios, raising alarm. Critics worry about the distinction between memes and actual policy signals from the president. Concerns about cognitive decline and national security implications are being voiced by analysts.
item.dc:creator: CHIDANAND RAJGHATTA

item.title: Vanessa Trump and Tiger Woods’ $50m TGR Foundation: How did she support him?
item.description: In early 2026, Vanessa Trump graced Tiger Woods' charity birthday event, marking a milestone for the TGR Foundation, which announced an impressive fifty million dollars raised for education. Shortly after, she subtly celebrated the TGR Learning Lab's anniversary, reinforcing her connection to Woods' commendable community outreach. Her attendance underscored the foundation's growing influence on young learners, showcasing the vital role they play in education.

item.title: Tom Brady’s message to Hannah after Michigan debut: What did he say?
item.description: Hannah Brady finally made her Michigan volleyball debut against Valparaiso, and she started with an ace on her first serve. Michigan won 3-1, and Tom Brady responded with a simple “So proud of you” on Instagram. After spending her freshman year without a match appearance, Hannah now has her first college moment to build on for the first time.

item.title: Shifting right? What AfD's victory in Germany means for Europe, Russia & US
item.description: Germany's AfD achieved significant electoral gains, signaling a potential rightward shift across Europe. This development challenges established political norms and impacts international alliances. Mainstream parties may adopt tougher stances on immigration and national sovereignty. The rise of the right presents varied approaches to Russia and Ukraine. This evolving political landscape will shape Europe's future direction and global standing.

item.description: The Supreme Court has firmly instructed the Aravalli expert panel to complete its report by November 30, denying any request for an extension. The court emphasized the need for the panel to engage with all relevant stakeholders prior to finalizing its recommendations. Should they fail to meet the deadline, the court will reconstitute the panel. An additional hearing is set for December 2.

item.title: 'Orwellian Dystopia’: HC raps Noida DM over student’s detention during workers' protest
item.description: The Allahabad High Court quashed the National Security Act detention of Akriti Chaudhary. The court ordered recovery of five lakh rupees from Gautam Buddha Nagar officials. This compensation will be paid to the Delhi University student activist. The bench criticized the arbitrary invocation of the stringent preventive detention law. Officials' conduct was noted in their service records for their actions.

item.title: 4 yrs, 2 building collapses in same South Delhi lane - the warning nobody acted on
item.description: Two building collapses occurred in South Delhi's Satya Niketan neighborhood. Both incidents were attributed to illegal construction and ignored official notices. The first collapse in 2022 killed two laborers and injured four more. A second collapse in 2026 killed at least seven and injured over a dozen students. Authorities are investigating both incidents and promising accountability for those responsible.

item.title: Robot army? How China is preparing for future battlefieds
item.description: China's military is dedicated to the exploration and development of humanoid robots, aiming to integrate them into upcoming combat scenarios. Several research institutions are rigorously testing these robots to meet specific combat needs while investing in advanced capabilities. The primary areas of focus include improving perception, manipulation, and training methods for operational efficacy.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: Traffic violations could cost driving licence points; Gadkari plans new rules
item.description: The proposed system would assign penalty points to motorists for different traffic offences. If a driver accumulates points beyond a specified limit, the authorities could suspend the driving licence or cancel it altogether.

item.title: 'Insulting label': In a first, Rahul responds to PM Modi's 'Dimagi Naxal' attack
item.description: Rahul Gandhi joined the debate over Prime Minister Modi's 'Dimagi Naxal' remarks. He accused the Prime Minister of using such labels to silence critics and avoid accountability. Earlier opposition leaders, including Arvind Kejriwal, had also expressed pride in being called 'Dimagi Naxals'. Union Minister Kiren Rijiju had then clarified the Prime Minister's remarks were not aimed at political rivals. But last week, Prime Minister Modi reiterated his stance, calling the label a 'homoeopathic pill'.
item.dc:creator: KUNAL VARMA

item.title: 7 dead in Delhi PG collapse: Hostel agreement said ‘not responsible’ for any tragedy
item.description: In the aftermath of the Satya Niketan building collapse, an alleged PG agreement was revealed, which relieved the hostel from any responsibility. This document specified that no compensation would be granted for injuries or losses. Such exclusions were applicable to disasters including fires, severe weather, and earthquakes. Seven individuals lost their lives in this unfortunate event.

item.title: 18 yrs ago, US govt took over 2 mortgage-finance giants amid 2008 crisis: Why it mattered
item.description: Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac entered government conservatorship in 2008. These mortgage giants remain under federal control after eighteen years. Treasury invested over $191 billion in the companies between 2008 and 2017. Recent agreements address their eventual release from government oversight. However, a definitive timeline for their exit from conservatorship is not yet confirmed.
item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: Mirror donated by spies, Red Fort-sized photos: Why Nasa's new telescope is special
item.description: NASA has successfully launched the Nancy Grace Roman telescope, a cutting-edge space observatory equipped with mirrors provided by the National Reconnaissance Office. Unlike Hubble, which observed a limited portion of the sky for three decades, Roman will cover fifty times more area. Its sophisticated camera will produce sweeping panoramic images, aiming to transform the landscape of astronomical research and discovery.
item.dc:creator: GOVIND VIJAYKUMAR

item.title: Space wars are no longer science fiction: How nations are preparing for conflict in orbit
item.description: Space is increasingly vital for modern warfare and global communication. Nations are enhancing their space-based military capabilities for persistent observation. India plans a satellite constellation for enhanced military situational awareness. The Outer Space Treaty governs activities and prohibits certain military actions. Protecting space assets is crucial as it dictates future conflict dynamics.
item.dc:creator: DHRUV YADAV

item.title: 'Shenzhen win has given us confidence': Satwik-Chirag turn focus to Asian Games
item.description: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty overcame injuries and a deficit to win their maiden China Masters title, defeating China's He Ji Ting and Ren Xiang Yu in Shenzhen. The victory erased the disappointment of their World Championships collapse, restored confidence in Satwik's recovering shoulder, and provided timely momentum before they defend their Asian Games gold.
item.dc:creator: TANUJ LAKHINA

item.title: Akhilesh's 'chavanni' jab: Can Jayant be BJP’s trump card in UP's 'jatland'?
item.description: Jayant Chaudhary's political relevance is highlighted by recent exchanges between political leaders. His party's success in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections boosted his standing. The Jat community's influence in western Uttar Pradesh remains politically significant. Chaudhary's alliance with the BJP aims to counter opposition strategies. Upcoming seat-sharing negotiations will determine his future political value.
item.dc:creator: PALLAVI
